plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official EMU catalog program page 'Program: Nursing [BSN]' (Major Requirements 77-78 hours; Nursing Core 71 hours) for all NURS course codes, titles, credits and the support courses (DTC 203, BIO 328 or CLSC 432); (2) the official EMU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Nursing Student Handbook for the Level 2/3/4 sequence, the C-or-better rule, and the DTC 203 + BIO 328-before-300-level requirement; (3) official School of Nursing program overview PDFs for the 8 preadmission prerequisite courses and their credits; (4) the official EMU General Education worksheet (FA22) for gen-ed structure and course tags; (5) the official catalog course page for NURS 375W prerequisites. catalog.emich.edu presents an AWS WAF challenge to automated fetching, so catalog content was verified through the search index of the official catalog pages and official emich.edu documents; every code, title and credit below comes from those official sources. TOTAL IS 129 CREDITS: the 78-hour major + 27 credits of preadmission prerequisites + 24 credits of gen-ed-only courses genuinely exceed the 120-credit university minimum - this is the honest minimum-credit path, not padding. BSN admission is separate and competitive (application due May 15; cohort starts the following Fall); Year 1 is the Nursing-Intent preadmission year. ANTH 135 fills the ANTH 135/SOCL 105 prereq slot and counts for Area III Global Awareness (one course may not satisfy both Perspectives and Knowledge of the Disciplines, so GEKS is SOCL 105 + PLSC 112). BIO 328 fills the BIO 328/CLSC 432 support slot. NURS 110 (2 cr, recommended for admission points) is not required and is not in the plan - ask an advisor about it. Verify semester offerings with the School of Nursing before registering.
